title: 第152章 我要进去看看！
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张瑀盯着面板上的三个方案，脑子飞快地转着。

方案一是最省香火值的，但成功率只有六成出头，而且失败之后碧水玄龟和青莲剑客都要被冻结七天。

他现在随时可能对上黄泉渡的渡主，这两个高端战力缺一不可。

方案二成功率九成，但要花五万香火值——他手里现在有十六万多，花五万倒不是花不起。

但Lv.4的人脉抽取本身还有一成失败的概率，万一翻车，两万五香火值就打水漂了。

方案三是最便宜的，几乎不花什么成本，但风险未知。

棺材里的东西要是提前醒过来，他一个炼气十二层站在人家脸上，怕是连跑都来不及。

他深吸了一口气，把三个方案在脑子里又过了一遍。

然后他做出了决定。

“系统，执行方案三——但要加个保险。调取人脉：掌刑天官，召唤至我身边，作为护卫。费用按紧急召唤算，香火值翻倍。”

【正在向掌刑天官发送委托邀请……邀请已发送，等待回应……掌刑天官已接受委托。】

【本次委托费用：基础服务费3000下品灵石，紧急召唤香火值消耗3600点。宿主当前香火值余额：165870点。预计到达时间：十息。】

张瑀关掉系统面板，转过身来对季伯渊说：“季宗主，我要亲自进去看看。”

季伯渊愣住了。“张小友，里面太危险了——”

“我有分寸。”张瑀的语气很笃定，“我不会贸然靠近棺材，只是在外围用我的方法探查一下里面的情况。另外，我已经叫了人过来，他会护着我进去。”

话音刚落，一道金色的光柱从天而降，直直地落在张瑀身侧几步远的地方。

光柱散去之后，原地出现了一个身穿金色官袍的高大男人。

官袍上绣着密密麻麻的刑狱纹路，腰间束着白玉腰带，头上戴着刑官冠，手里握着一柄淡金色的尺。

掌刑天官。

他往那儿一站，周身散发出来的威压让在场的几位天符宗长老同时往后退了半步。

二长老倒吸了一口凉气。

他修行近两百年，自问见过不少高人，但眼前这位金袍人的气息——他完全感应不到深浅。

不是收敛了，而是像一口深不见底的古井，扔一块石头下去，听不到落地的回响。

三长老的反应更直接，他下意识地将手按在了腰间的法器上，但手指刚碰到法器边缘就僵住了。

他意识到这个动作毫无意义。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhang Yu stared at the three plans on the panel, his mind spinning rapidly.

Option one is the most cost-effective, but the success rate is only a little over 60%, and if it fails, both the Black Water Turtle and the Green Lotus Swordsman will be frozen for seven days.

He may face the ferry master of Huangquandu at any time now, and these two high-end combat powers are indispensable.

Plan 2 has a 90% success rate, but it will cost 50,000 incense points - he currently has more than 160,000 in hand, so 50,000 is not something he can't afford.

However, there is still a 10% chance of failure in extracting contacts at Level 4. If it overturns, the 25,000 incense value will be wasted.

Option three is the cheapest, costing almost nothing, but the risks are unknown.

If the thing in the coffin wakes up early, he may not even have time to run away if he stands in front of someone at the twelfth level of Qi Refining.

He took a deep breath and went through the three plans in his mind.

Then he made his decision.

"System, implement plan three - but add insurance. Recruit contacts: Zhangxing Tianguan, summon to my side as a guard. The cost is calculated as an emergency summons, and the incense value is doubled."

[Sending a commission invitation to Zhangxing Tianguan... The invitation has been sent, waiting for response... Zhangxing Tianguan has accepted the commission.】

[The fee for this commission: the basic service fee is 3,000 low-grade spiritual stones, and the emergency summoning incense value consumes 3,600 points.The host's current incense value balance: 165870 points.ETA: ten breaths.】

Zhang Yu turned off the system panel, turned around and said to Ji Boyuan: "Sect Leader Ji, I want to go in and see for myself."

Ji Boyuan was stunned."Zhang Xiaoyou, it's too dangerous inside -"

"I am measured." Zhang Yu's tone was very firm. "I will not approach the coffin rashly. I will just use my own methods to explore the situation inside. In addition, I have already called someone over, and he will escort me in."

As soon as he finished speaking, a golden beam of light fell from the sky and landed directly a few steps away from Zhang Yu.

After the light beam dispersed, a tall man wearing a golden official robe appeared on the spot.

The official robe is embroidered with dense prison patterns, a white jade belt is tied around the waist, a prison crown is worn on the head, and a pale golden ruler is held in his hand.

The official in charge of punishment.

He stood there, and the coercion emanating from his body made several Tianfu Sect elders present take half a step back at the same time.

The second elder took a breath of cold air.

He has been practicing for nearly two hundred years and has seen many masters, but the aura of the golden-robed man in front of him - he can't sense the depth at all.

It's not that it's restrained, but it's like an ancient well with no bottom. If you throw a stone down, you won't hear the echo when it hits the ground.

The third elder's reaction was more direct. He subconsciously placed his hand on the magic weapon at his waist, but froze as soon as his fingers touched the edge of the magic weapon.

He realized the action was pointless.
